subject: Timezone label absent from downloaded report

thread.author: Oliver / Northwind
thread.message: The report view is in Sydney time but the downloaded timestamp lacks an offset. The team cannot tell whether midnight rows belong to the previous reporting day.

thread.author: Support / Ravi
thread.message: The export uses UTC. A documentation update is drafted, and product is reviewing an explicit timezone column. We have not supplied a dated release commitment.

thread.author: Oliver / Northwind
thread.message: Thanks for the UTC explanation. Please keep us informed about the column label change; our reconciliation script still needs the explicit offset.

next_action: Share UTC workaround and track the labeling request with product.
